tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi'i byin rlabs kyi bka' bzhugs so// bde ba'i dpal rgyun mi nub rdzogs ldan dpyid/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /dge legs rab tu bstan pa'i dbyangs bdun khrol/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /'dir mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi'i byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal dbus dkar dmar/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i 'dab ma bzhi mtha' me ris 'bar ba/ dbus su tshom bu dkar dmar gcig 'god/ mchod gtor sogs dkyus bzhin/ de nas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ dbu skra sil bur 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'phyar tsam mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi rnam pa/ spyan gsum hrig ge gzigs pa/ ye shes kyi sku can/ de'i gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ oṃ āḥsu kha sid+dhi hūm̐ nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ ༈ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su tshang ba'i dbus na/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la su kha sid+dhi sngar bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa sngar dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin brlab la/ oṃ su kha sid+dhi sa pā ri wa ra re sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ gang gi drin sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma yang byin brlabs la mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang bstod pa 'dod gsol bya/ de nas 'jug pa'i maṇ+ḍal nas bzung ye shes dbab pa/

dbang bzhi blang ba/ nam mkha' dang rang sems bsres nas gnas lugs kyi ngang du rang babs su 'jog pa'i bar bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang / de nas slob ma bos la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs dang / gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la bla ma mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ rdo rje 'chang la chos dngos su gsan pa'i ye shes kyi ḍā ki rnam pa gnyis kyi nang mtshan/ su kha sid+dhi'i byin rlabs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sgrub zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i ngos skal du gyur pa la/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ dga' chen sogs kyi gsol btab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi rgyun bshags/ slob ma su khar bskyed la ye shes pa bstim la/ ḍā dril dang sngar gyi sngags kyi mthar/ a bhe sha ya a a btags pa brjod/ de nas mdun gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i su kha sid+dhi bzhugs pa la dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gang drin sho lo ka gcig gi mthar bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol btags pa lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal btab/ dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po byung khyed rang gi smin mtshams nas bzhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang bcas pa'i ḍā dril bya/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po byung / khyed rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang dang / thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung / slob ma'i snying khar thim pas sher dbang dang / mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung / slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob pa sogs rigs 'dre/ re re la sngags dang bcas pa'i ḍā dril re bya/ mthar slob ma lus gnad bcas/ mig mdun gyi bar snang stong pa la har re gtad du bcug

slob dpon mkha' 'gro ma su khar gsal ba'i phyag g.yon khu tshur la mdzub mo nam mkhar sgreng ba skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'chag tsam mdzad de/ nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ /rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba bcun/ /rtsa ba bcun la lhug par bzhogs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de'i don nam mkha' dang khyed rang gi sems dbyer med du bsres nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la skye 'jig med pa bzhin du rang sems la skye 'jig med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus dang ngos bzung ci yang med pa bzhin/ rang sems kyang de ltar shes par byas la de ka'i ngang du 'dzin pa mi bya/ bcas bcos mi bya bar rang babs su bzhog ces brjod/ rjes gtso bo sogs dang yig brgyas nongs pa bzod sogs 'dra/ 'di la nges par tshogs 'khor gcig mdzad gsung / mthar bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi 'phreng bas mtha' brten par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi dran du gyur pa dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung gi zin tho la brten/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du lcags pho 'brug lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin mdar grang chen chos 'khor yangs rtse'i bla brang gi dbang khang gsang chen chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad pa sgrog pa'i gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 ngag dbang chos grags/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi'i byin rlabs kyi bka'/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
